import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import sys
import warnings
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.feature_selection import SelectKBest, chi2
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

# Suppress warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Define paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
try:
    train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
    test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))
except FileNotFoundError as e:
    print(f"Error loading data: {e}")
    sys.exit(1)

# Check if sample submission exists
sample_sub_path = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission_null.csv")
if os.path.exists(sample_sub_path):
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_sub_path)
    submit_cols = sample_sub.columns.tolist()
    print(f"Sample submission columns: {submit_cols}")
else:
    submit_cols = ["Comment", "Date", "Insult"]


# Preprocessing - keep original comment for submission
def clean_comment(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text).strip()
    if len(text) > 1 and text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
        text = text[1:-1]
    return text


# Create clean version for training but preserve original for submission
train_df["Comment_Clean"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_comment)
test_df["Comment_Clean"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_comment)

# Split training data for validation
X_train_full = train_df["Comment_Clean"]
y_train_full = train_df["Insult"]

X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full,
    y_train_full,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_full,
    shuffle=True,
)

# Feature Engineering
vectorizer_word1 = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=50000, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words="english"
)
vectorizer_char1 = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=50000, analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(3, 5), stop_words="english"
)

vectorizer_word2 = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=50000, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words="english", sublinear_tf=True
)
vectorizer_char2 = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=50000,
    analyzer="char_wb",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    stop_words="english",
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Transform all data (fit on training data only)
X_train_word1 = vectorizer_word1.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_word1 = vectorizer_word1.transform(X_val)
X_test_word1 = vectorizer_word1.transform(test_df["Comment_Clean"])

X_train_char1 = vectorizer_char1.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_char1 = vectorizer_char1.transform(X_val)
X_test_char1 = vectorizer_word1.transform(test_df["Comment_Clean"])

X_train_word2 = vectorizer_word2.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_word2 = vectorizer_word2.transform(X_val)
X_test_word2 = vectorizer_word2.transform(test_df["Comment_Clean"])

X_train_char2 = vectorizer_char2.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_char2 = vectorizer_char2.transform(X_val)
X_test_char2 = vectorizer_char2.transform(test_df["Comment_Clean"])

# Apply chi-squared feature selection
selector_word1 = SelectKBest(chi2, k=15000)
X_train_word1_sel = selector_word1.fit_transform(X_train_word1, y_train)
X_val_word1_sel = selector_word1.transform(X_val_word1)
X_test_word1_sel = selector_word1.transform(X_test_word1)

selector_char1 = SelectKBest(chi2, k=15000)
X_train_char1_sel = selector_char1.fit_transform(X_train_char1, y_train)
X_val_char1_sel = selector_char1.transform(X_val_char1)
X_test_char1_sel = selector_char1.transform(X_test_char1)

selector_word2 = SelectKBest(chi2, k=15000)
X_train_word2_sel = selector_word2.fit_transform(X_train_word2, y_train)
X_val_word2_sel = selector_word2.transform(X_val_word2)
X_test_word2_sel = selector_word2.transform(X_test_word2)

selector_char2 = SelectKBest(chi2, k=15000)
X_train_char2_sel = selector_char2.fit_transform(X_train_char2, y_train)
X_val_char2_sel = selector_char2.transform(X_val_char2)
X_test_char2_sel = selector_char2.transform(X_test_char2)

# Concatenate features after selection
X_train1 = np.hstack([X_train_word1_sel.toarray(), X_train_char1_sel.toarray()])
X_val1 = np.hstack([X_val_word1_sel.toarray(), X_val_char1_sel.toarray()])
X_test1 = np.hstack([X_test_word1_sel.toarray(), X_test_char1_sel.toarray()])

X_train2 = np.hstack([X_train_word2_sel.toarray(), X_train_char2_sel.toarray()])
X_val2 = np.hstack([X_val_word2_sel.toarray(), X_val_char2_sel.toarray()])
X_test2 = np.hstack([X_test_word2_sel.toarray(), X_test_char2_sel.toarray()])

y_train = y_train.values
y_val = y_val.values

# Train two Logistic Regression models with C=2.0 (optimal)
model1 = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, solver="lbfgs", C=2.0, random_state=42)
model1.fit(X_train1, y_train)
val_preds1 = model1.predict_proba(X_val1)[:, 1]

model2 = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, solver="lbfgs", C=2.0, random_state=42)
model2.fit(X_train2, y_train)
val_preds2 = model2.predict_proba(X_val2)[:, 1]

# Train Gradient Boosting model on features 1 (complementary boosting perspective)
gb_model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=100, max_depth=3, learning_rate=0.1, random_state=42
)
gb_model.fit(X_train1, y_train)
val_preds3 = gb_model.predict_proba(X_val1)[:, 1]

print(f"Model 1 AUC (no sublinear_tf): {roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds1):.6f}")
print(f"Model 2 AUC (with sublinear_tf): {roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds2):.6f}")
print(f"Model 3 AUC (Gradient Boosting): {roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds3):.6f}")

# Ensemble predictions (average probabilities)
val_preds_ensemble = (val_preds1 + val_preds2 + val_preds3) / 3
val_auc_ensemble = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds_ensemble)
print(f"3-Model Ensemble Validation AUC: {val_auc_ensemble:.6f}")

# Final models trained on FULL training data for test predictions
X_train_full_word1 = vectorizer_word1.transform(X_train_full)
X_train_full_char1 = vectorizer_char1.transform(X_train_full)

# Apply feature selection on full data using same selectors
X_train_full_word1_sel = selector_word1.transform(X_train_full_word1)
X_train_full_char1_sel = selector_char1.transform(X_train_full_char1)
X_train_full1 = np.hstack(
    [X_train_full_word1_sel.toarray(), X_train_full_char1_sel.toarray()]
)

final_model1 = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, solver="lbfgs", C=2.0, random_state=42)
final_model1.fit(X_train_full1, y_train_full.values)

X_train_full_word2 = vectorizer_word2.transform(X_train_full)
X_train_full_char2 = vectorizer_char2.transform(X_train_full)

# Apply feature selection on full data using same selectors
X_train_full_word2_sel = selector_word2.transform(X_train_full_word2)
X_train_full_char2_sel = selector_char2.transform(X_train_full_char2)
X_train_full2 = np.hstack(
    [X_train_full_word2_sel.toarray(), X_train_full_char2_sel.toarray()]
)

final_model2 = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, solver="lbfgs", C=2.0, random_state=42)
final_model2.fit(X_train_full2, y_train_full.values)

# Gradient Boosting final model
gb_model.fit(X_train_full1, y_train_full.values)

# Test predictions
X_test_full_word1 = vectorizer_word1.transform(test_df["Comment_Clean"])
X_test_full_char1 = vectorizer_char1.transform(test_df["Comment_Clean"])

# Apply feature selection on test data using same selectors
X_test_full_word1_sel = selector_word1.transform(X_test_full_word1)
X_test_full_char1_sel = selector_char1.transform(X_test_full_char1)
X_test_full1 = np.hstack(
    [X_test_full_word1_sel.toarray(), X_test_full_char1_sel.toarray()]
)

test_preds1 = final_model1.predict_proba(X_test_full1)[:, 1]

X_test_full_word2 = vectorizer_word2.transform(test_df["Comment_Clean"])
X_test_full_char2 = vectorizer_char2.transform(test_df["Comment_Clean"])

# Apply feature selection on test data using same selectors
X_test_full_word2_sel = selector_word2.transform(X_test_full_word2)
X_test_full_char2_sel = selector_char2.transform(X_test_full_char2)
X_test_full2 = np.hstack(
    [X_test_full_word2_sel.toarray(), X_test_full_char2_sel.toarray()]
)

test_preds2 = final_model2.predict_proba(X_test_full2)[:, 1]

# Gradient Boosting test predictions
test_preds3 = gb_model.predict_proba(X_test_full1)[:, 1]

# Ensemble predictions
test_preds_ensemble = (test_preds1 + test_preds2 + test_preds3) / 3

# Ensure predictions are float64
test_preds_ensemble = np.array(test_preds_ensemble, dtype=np.float64)

# Create Submission with explicit column mapping to sample_submission format
# Order must match: Comment, Date, Insult
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Comment": test_df["Comment"].values,
        "Date": test_df["Date"].values,
        "Insult": test_preds_ensemble,
    }
)

# Verify Insult column is numeric
print(f"Insult column dtype: {submission['Insult'].dtype}")
print(f"Insult sample values: {submission['Insult'].head().tolist()}")
print(f"Test predictions shape: {test_preds_ensemble.shape}")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")

submission.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Validation AUC: {val_auc_ensemble:.6f}")
